stem: Consider the structures of the three cyclic carbon compounds A, B and C given below and select the correct option from the following:

options.label: A
options.text: A and C are isomers of hexane and B is benzene.

options.label: B
options.text: A is a saturated cyclic hydrocarbon and B and C are unsaturated cyclic hydrocarbons.

options.label: C
options.text: A is cyclohexane and B and C are the isomers of benzene.

options.label: D
options.text: A is an isomer of hexane, B is benzene and C is an isomer of hexene.

stem: Which of the following represent the formula \(C_6H_{14}\)?

options.text: A, B and D

options.label: B
options.text: A and C

options.label: C
options.text: All of these

options.label: D
options.text: A and B

stem: The correct electron dot structure of a water molecule is

options.label: A
options.text: \(H:\overset{..}{\underset{..}{O}}\cdot H\)

options.label: C
options.text: \(H:\overset{..}{\underset{..}{O}}:H\)

options.label: D
options.text: \(H\cdot\overset{..}{\underset{..}{O}}\cdot H\)

stem: The correct structural formula of butanoic acid is

options.label: A
options.text: Four-carbon straight chain ending in a carboxyl group: \(CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-COOH\)

options.label: B
options.text: Four-carbon straight chain ending in \(-C(H)(H)-OH\) (no carbonyl)

options.label: C
options.text: Four-carbon chain with a \(C=C\) double bond ending in a carboxyl group

options.label: D
options.text: Five-carbon straight chain ending in a carboxyl group: \(CH_3-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-COOH\)

stem: The structural formula of Cyclohexane is

options.label: A
options.text: Six-membered carbon ring with three \(C=C\) double bonds

options.label: B
options.text: Six-membered carbon ring with all single bonds, each carbon bonded to two hydrogen atoms

options.label: C
options.text: Six-membered carbon ring with two \(C=C\) double bonds

options.label: D
options.text: Six-membered carbon ring with two \(C\equiv C\) triple bonds
